description: West Virginia SNAP provides grocery benefits through the Mountain State EBT Card. Apply on WV PATH and complete the application and interview requested by DoHS.
introduction: West Virginia SNAP provides grocery benefits through the Mountain State EBT Card. Apply on WV PATH and complete the application and interview requested by DoHS.

who: Households whose income, assets where applicable and household expenses meet SNAP rules.
DoHS determines household size and any student or work requirements relevant to the applicant.
sections.get: Monthly food purchasing benefits for approved households. The state EBT office lists eligible foods and seeds as covered purchases.
sections.docs: Prepare income, household membership and shelter or other relevant expense information. File a signed application first and ask the worker what proof is needed to complete review.
sections.apply:
1. Select SNAP in WV PATH and create an account or use the available guest application route.
  2. You can establish the application filing date with name, residence address and a valid signature.
  3. Finish the full application, complete the interview and return requested proof.
  4. Explain any urgent food shortage to the county office and ask about expedited processing.
sections.after: Watch for the interview letter and PATH messages. A partial application alone is not approval. Follow the case reporting and renewal instructions. For card loss or balance assistance, the EBT office lists 866-545-6502.

faqs: Can I begin with an incomplete application?
Yes, PATH explains the signed minimum application establishes the SNAP filing date; further application and interview steps remain.
Do I need an email address?
The state provides a partial SNAP application route without an email account.
Can the card be used for cash withdrawals from SNAP?
SNAP is a food benefit; WV WORKS cash uses a separate benefit balance.
Does an online screening approve benefits?
No; apply and complete DoHS review.
What if my EBT card is lost?
Call the published EBT helpline at 866-545-6502.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
